source.title: Examine the Vessel
source.description: Examine the vessel that was used to release the ephemeral storm. It is from this that the Windseeker was reborn, and now he draws upon The Crystal Vale for renewed power.
source.progress: Will you harness the contained power from the Windseekers prison?
source.completion: May you be protected in your crusade. May the Master bless your efforts.
